name: research-toolkit
description: Complete research methods for in-depth analysis, long-form reports and revisions.

interface.longDescription: Understand the research request, develop source-backed comparisons and explanations, and deliver well-reasoned reports. Load complete methods as needed and preserve useful work across revisions.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Research Toolkit to research or revise this topic. Establish the requirements from context, use the complete methods as needed, and deliver a fully developed report with usable citations.
